name: Create ProxyDB for DirectConnector
description: Create Proxy-Database having the tables containing in the DirectConnector
statement:
/*
In case the database referencing by DirectConnector is missing on your local SQL Server, 
you can create a Proxy-Database having the tables and columns containing in the DirectConnector.
After Proxy-DB is created, the syncronisation will be finished without errors.
*/

SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE 
	@ConnectorID int = :1

DECLARE 
	@DB sysname,
	@Server sysname,
	@SourceID int = -1,
	@Source_Schema sysname,
	@Source_Name sysname,
	@ID int = -1,
	@col nvarchar(4000),
	@cols nvarchar(max),
	@sql nvarchar(max),
	@Column_Name sysname,
	@PK nvarchar(4000)

SELECT
	@DB = DatabaseName,
	@Server = ServerName
FROM
	CFG.CONNECTORS
WHERE
	ConnectorID = @ConnectorID AND
	ConnectorTypeID = 9

IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CFG.CONNECTORS WHERE ConnectorID = @ConnectorID AND ConnectorTypeID = 9)
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Invalid ConnectorID %i. Only Direct-Connectors can be used', 16, 1, @ConnectorID)
	RETURN
END

IF @Server IS NOT NULL AND @Server <> ''
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Cannot create proxy-DB because server name is not empty. Server name: %s', 16, 1, @Server)
	RETURN
END

IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.databases WHERE name = @DB) 
BEGIN
	RAISERROR('Cannot create proxy-DB [%s] because it already exists', 16, 1, @DB)
	RETURN
END

SET @sql = 'CREATE DATABASE ' + QUOTENAME(@DB)
EXEC(@sql)

DECLARE @T TABLE (ID int NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1), col nvarchar(4000), PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED(ID))

WHILE 1=1 
BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1
		@SourceID = SourceID,
		@Source_Schema = Source_Schema,
		@Source_Name = Source_Name
	FROM 
		CFG.SOURCES 
	WHERE 
		ConnectorID = @ConnectorID AND
		SourceID > @SourceID
	ORDER BY
		SourceID

	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK

	DELETE FROM @T
	INSERT INTO @T(col)
	SELECT
		QUOTENAME(SC.Column_Name) + ' ' + 
		QUOTENAME(T.SrcType) + 
				CASE 
					WHEN T.hasLength = 1 AND ISNULL(SC.Character_Maximum_Length, 0) <> 0 THEN '(' + CASE WHEN SC.Character_Maximum_Length = -1 THEN 'MAX' ELSE CAST(SC.Character_Maximum_Length AS VARCHAR(5)) END + ')'
					WHEN T.hasScale = 1 AND T.hasPrecision = 1 AND ISNULL(SC.Numeric_Precision, 0) <> 0 AND SC.Numeric_Scale IS NOT NULL THEN '(' + CAST(SC.Numeric_Precision AS nvarchar(5)) + ',' + CAST(SC.Numeric_Scale AS nvarchar(5)) + ')'
					WHEN T.hasPrecision = 1 AND ISNULL(SC.Numeric_Precision, 0) <> 0 THEN '(' + CAST(SC.Numeric_Precision AS nvarchar(5)) + ')'
					WHEN T.hasScale = 1 AND ISNULL(SC.Numeric_Scale, 0) <> 0 THEN '(' + CAST(SC.Numeric_Scale AS nvarchar(5)) + ')'
					ELSE ''
				END + 
		CASE WHEN SC.Is_Nullable = 1 THEN ' NULL' ELSE ' NOT NULL' END
		FROM
			CFG.SOURCE_COLUMNS SC
			INNER JOIN INTERN.TYPES T ON
				T.TypeID = SC.TypeID
		WHERE
			SourceID = @SourceID
		ORDER BY
			SC.OrderNr,
			SC.SourceColumnID

	SET @ID = -1
	SET @cols = ''
	SET @PK = ''

	WHILE 1=1
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1
			@ID = ID,
			@col = col
		FROM
			@T
		WHERE
			ID > @ID
		ORDER BY
			ID

		IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK
		SET @cols = @cols + CASE WHEN @cols = '' THEN '' ELSE ',
	' END + @col

	END

	SELECT 
		@PK = @PK + CASE WHEN @PK = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + QUOTENAME(Column_Name)
	FROM
		CFG.SOURCE_COLUMNS
	WHERE
		SourceID = @SourceID AND
		PK_Ordinal_Position IS NOT NULL
	ORDER BY 
		PK_Ordinal_Position		

	SET @sql = '
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [' + @DB + '].sys.schemas WHERE name =  ''' + @Source_Schema + ''')
BEGIN
	DECLARE @s nvarchar(4000) = ''CREATE SCHEMA [' + @Source_Schema + ']''
	EXEC [' + @DB + '].dbo.sp_executesql @s
END

IF OBJECT_ID(''' + QUOTENAME(@DB) + '.' + + QUOTENAME(@Source_Schema) + '.' + QUOTENAME(@Source_Name) + ''', ''U'') IS NOT NULL
	DROP TABLE ' + QUOTENAME(@DB) + '.' + + QUOTENAME(@Source_Schema) + '.' + QUOTENAME(@Source_Name) + '

CREATE TABLE ' + QUOTENAME(@DB) + '.' + QUOTENAME(@Source_Schema) + '.' + QUOTENAME(@Source_Name) + '
(
	' + @cols + CASE WHEN @PK <> '' THEN ',
	CONSTRAINT ' + QUOTENAME('PK_' + @Source_Schema + '_' + @Source_Name) + ' PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED(' + @PK + ')' ELSE '' END + '
)'
--	PRINT @sql
	EXEC(@sql)
END
